summary_i18n.en: $NBIS's convertible financing ultimately reached $5.75B, above both the initially floated $4.5B and the $5.0B pricing size, while the conversion price remains 40%-45% above the current stock, suggesting credit investors are underwriting a higher future valuation. Key tickers: $NBIS

items.summary: NTDOY的多头逻辑是，市场还在像2017年那样盯着主机销量，但公司盈利核心已转向软件与数字分发。尽管上季度硬件销量同比下滑34%，股价几乎没受影响；同期数字销售同比增长90%，第一方软件占总软件销售82.6%，单季营业利润增长150%，且Q1营收与净利润均超预期、净利润同比增长超50%。在软件结构改善、利润率扩张、Fire Emblem、Zelda、Pokemon等产品线支撑下，股价仍明显低于52周高点，意味着市场尚未充分反映其高利润化转型。 重点标的: $NTDOY

summary_i18n.en: The bullish case for NTDOY is that the market is still fixated on console unit sales like it was in 2017, while the real earnings engine has shifted to software and digital distribution. Even though hardware fell 34% YoY last quarter, the stock barely reacted; meanwhile digital sales rose 90% YoY, first-party software made up 82.6% of total software sales, operating profit climbed 150% for the quarter, and Q1 revenue and net profit both beat estimates with profit up more than 50% YoY. With improving software mix, expanding margins, and support from franchises like Fire Emblem, Zelda, and Pokemon, the stock still sits well below its 52-week high, suggesting the market has not fully priced in the higher-margin business transition. Key tickers: $NTDOY
